title: Just purchased my second one ...
text:
Just purchased my second one .... My first one was purchased in late 2008, and was used 4 or 5 times a month. It finally broke this morning trying to open a badly stuck jam jar lid. Four years of use for less than $20: yep, I definitely got my money's worth.

My first one could be a tad "finicky" at times, but it ALWAYS worked fine on everything from pickle jars to home-canned jars. Also, it's rather particular about battery strength, so bear that in mind if you use yours a lot. If the batteries are weak (but not yet dead), it might not be able to remove a particularly tight lid.

I'm hoping to get the same performance out of this replacement.

UPDATE 10/25/2013 ....
My second one broke this morning while opening a jar of preserves. They definitely are NOT making them like they used to. My first one was a champ; this one opened maybe 10 jars before breaking. It was good while it lasted.

Bottom line: if you're going to open only jars that aren't too tightly closed, this might be OK. But I just ordered a "manual" opener as a replacement. I'm done with the "automated" ones, arthritis or no.

product_metadata.title: OneTouch Jar Opener
features: Simple touch and go action; works on all jars of all sizes
No more wrestling or twisting; opens from the top of the jar lid
Saves time, frustration and aggravation, battery operated (batteries not included)
The jar opener will not operate when the battery cover is removed from the unit
description: Don't let jar lids defeat you. With the OneTouch Jar Opener, you'll be able to twist off jar lids that are seemingly impossible to open. The One Touch Jar Opener is completely automatic and safe--just a single touch of a button and your jar opens in seconds. It grips nearly any size jar firmly and clamps itself onto the lid. Then the powerful, high-torque motor exerts up to 25 pounds of force to unlock the lid, releasing the seal with ease. The OneTouch Jar Opener opens all jars with 1-inch to 4-inch diameter lids and is powered by two AA batteries (not included). It stores conveniently in your kitchen drawer.
The OneTouch Jar Opener makes short work of even the most impossible-to-open jar.
